trials.claimQuote:
Lifetime access to SmatLeads
- You must redeem your code(s) within 60 days of purchase
- All future Starter Plan updates
trials.reasoning: E1 is a single opinion that the product was abandoned, but it does not show that buyers lost access or that lifetime access was revoked.

exhibits.quote: another dead tool and owner is focused on a new venture. product is left for dead
exhibits.argument: Directly contradicts lifetime access by reporting the product is abandoned by the owner.

trials.claim: Plan 1 includes 5,000 credits per month for GBP, Bing, and LinkedIn leads searches
trials.claimQuote: 5,000 credits per month for GBP, Bing, and LinkedIn leads searches
trials.reasoning: Two buyers report post-purchase search caps, including only 3 searches per day, making the advertised 5,000 monthly credits materially unusable without their own API keys.

exhibits.quote: they implemented a very small search limit after we purchased so there is no way we could even use the credits - they told us to get our own API keys… not sure what we paid for in that case.
exhibits.argument: Shows advertised monthly credits are unusable due to post-purchase daily search limits requiring own API keys.

exhibits.quote: it only give you around 20 business when you search, then after searching 3 areas say dallas, fort worth, austin tx. it reads you have used all 3 searches for today you must wait 24 hours.
exhibits.argument: Demonstrates Plan 1 cannot deliver 5,000 credits per month because searches are capped at 3 per day.

trials.claim: Plan 2 includes 10,000 credits per month for GBP, Bing, and LinkedIn leads searches
trials.claimQuote: 10,000 credits per month for GBP, Bing, and LinkedIn leads searches
trials.reasoning: A Tier 2 buyer reports only about 650 leads per month instead of 10,000, and another reports a five-search daily cap inconsistent with using thousands of monthly credits.

exhibits.quote: We have a Tier 2 liscence that claims up to 10,000 emails/month - and we are averaging 60 - 120 per search and a total volume 650 PER MONTH. This is not what we paid for.
exhibits.argument: Buyer with Tier 2 reports receiving only 650 per month instead of promised 10,000 credits.

exhibits.quote: We were told we can only perform five searches per day for GMB, which is not reasonable for thousands of credits.
exhibits.argument: Five searches per day cap makes reaching 10,000 monthly credits impossible.

trials.claim: All future Starter Plan updates included
trials.claimQuote:
You must redeem your code(s) within 60 days of purchase
- All future Starter Plan updates
- Stack up to 2 codes
trials.reasoning: A buyer on the maximum Tier 5 plan reports being asked to pay extra for updated functionality, directly conflicting with future updates being included.

exhibits.quote: I am on the maximum Tier 5 plan, yet I keep receiving emails telling me I need to pay extra to get access to the updated functionality.
exhibits.argument: Contradicts promise of all future updates included by showing even max tier must pay extra for updates.
